system.description:
The desert trackers of Tariel — experts in arid terrain, ambush, and reading the land.

  • Desert-Marked: Combat Marauder damage bonus applies to desert beasts and Tariel tribal enemies in addition to humanoids and giants.
  • Sand Reader: Advantage on all Survival and Track checks in arid or desert terrain.
